title: T1055.015 — Process Injection - ListPlanting
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Process Injection - ListPlanting with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated simulation of ListPlanting: an attacker copies shellcode into a Windows list-view control with LVM window messages, triggers it as the ListView_SortItems callback with LVM_SORTITEMS, executes code inside explorer.exe, and beacons to a command-and-control server while a SOC panel fills with matching alerts. A written transcript follows below.

steps.title: Foothold
steps.caption: The operator lands on the Windows endpoint through a lab loader. It runs as an unsigned svchost.exe copy in a user Temp folder. suspicious process creation from Temp; native logs show the loader start but nothing about injection yet
steps.defender: EDR and Sysmon record the process, memory and image-load events. Correlate them with the parent process.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Window discovery
steps.caption: The loader enumerates windows in the session and looks for the window class SysListView32 . It finds one hosted by explorer.exe . sparse native telemetry. Windows event logs do not record window classes or window messages; only EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) or ETW (Event Tracing for Windows) data can show this scan

steps.caption: The control runs its sort routine and calls the callback in the planted buffer. The shellcode now runs inside explorer.exe . unbacked RWX (Readable, Writable, and Executable) memory executes in explorer.exe. Memory scanning flags a region with no file on disk behind it

steps.caption: The implant now runs in a trusted, signed process. It beacons to its C2 (Command and Control) server over HTTPS (encrypted web traffic) from explorer.exe . unusual outbound HTTPS from explorer.exe. Network telemetry ties the flow to the alerting process ID

steps.title: Response
steps.caption: The SOC isolates the endpoint, captures memory, and scans GUI processes for unbacked RWX regions. Analysts tune the EDR rules that caught the message storm. containment confirmed. The implant died with the isolate action. The memory image confirms the injected region
